eval: (() => { const ks = []; for (let i = localStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.startsWith('dao-')) ks.push(k); } ks.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)); location.reload(); return 'cleared'; })()

(() => { window.__dao.setStage(12); document.getElementById('btn-talents').click(); const click = id => document.querySelector(`.tnode[data-id="${id}"]`).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); ['b1','b2'].forEach(click); document.getElementById('talent-close').click(); window.__dao.clear(); window.__dao.place('daotong'); window.__dao.place('taomu-jian', 'held'); window.__dao.place('tongjing', 'station'); window.__dao.place('waci-yin', 'station'); return JSON.stringify(window.__dao.state.playerQueue.map(u => [u.cardId, u.mode || u.cardType])); })()

(async () => { const held = document.querySelector('.unit-card.held'); const st = document.querySelector('.unit-card.stationed'); const st2 = document.querySelectorAll('.unit-card.stationed')[1]; const ch = document.querySelector('.unit-card[data-card-id="daotong"]'); const en = document.querySelector('#enemy-cards .unit-card'); const samp = async (el, n, dt) => { const ys = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { ys.push(el.getBoundingClientRect().top); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, dt)); } return +(Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys)).toFixed(2); }; const [hd, sd, sd2, cd, ed] = [await samp(held, 14, 150), await samp(st, 14, 150), await samp(st2, 14, 150), await samp(ch, 14, 150), await samp(en, 14, 150)]; const phase = getComputedStyle(st).animationDelay !== getComputedStyle(st2).animationDelay; return JSON.stringify({ heldDrift: hd, stationDrift: sd, station2Drift: sd2, charDrift: cd, enemyDrift: ed, phaseStaggered: phase, delays: [getComputedStyle(st).animationDelay, getComputedStyle(st2).animationDelay] }); })()
(() => { const st = window.__dao.state.playerQueue.find(u => u.mode === 'station'); const r = window.__dao.hit(st.uid, 99999); return JSON.stringify({ hit: r, status: st.status }); })()

(async () => { const el = document.querySelector('.unit-card.stationed.corpse'); if (!el) return 'no corpse card'; const ys = []; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { ys.push(el.getBoundingClientRect().top); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 160)); } return JSON.stringify({ corpseDrift: +(Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys)).toFixed(2), anim: getComputedStyle(el).animationName }); })()

(() => { window.__dao.setStage(2); document.getElementById('btn-reset').click(); const p = window.__dao; p.clear(); p.place('daotong'); p.place('taomu-jian', 'held'); p.place('tongjing', 'station'); p.start(); const s = p.state; const c = s.playerQueue.find(u => u.cardType === 'char'); c.maxHp = 9999; c.hp = 9999; s.enemyQueue.forEach(u => { u.maxHp = 5000; u.hp = 5000; }); return JSON.stringify({ running: s.running, lineup: s.playerQueue.map(u => [u.cardId, u.mode || u.cardType]) }); })()

(async () => { const q = window.__dao.state.playerQueue; const held = q.find(u => u.mode === 'held'); const ch = q.find(u => u.cardType === 'char'); const st = q.find(u => u.mode === 'station'); const mx = { held: 0, char: 0, station: 0 }; const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 7000) { for (const [k, u] of [['held', held], ['char', ch], ['station', st]]) { const el = document.querySelector(`.unit-card[data-uid="${u.uid}"]`); if (!el || !el.classList.contains('atk-anim')) continue; const tr = getComputedStyle(el).transform; const m = tr && tr.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/); if (m) { const p = m[1].split(',').map(Number); const d = Math.hypot(p[4], p[5]); if (d > mx[k]) mx[k] = d; } } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 16)); } return JSON.stringify({ heldMaxPunch: +mx.held.toFixed(1), charMaxPunch: +mx.char.toFixed(1), stationMaxPunch: +mx.station.toFixed(1), heldStronger: mx.held > Math.max(mx.char, mx.station) * 1.5 }); })()
